task: Review this error-handling passage for claims about automatic retry behavior that go beyond what the supplied client reference documents. The reference describes 503 responses but contains no retry specification.
input: When a 503 response is received, the client automatically retries the request up to three times with exponential backoff starting at 1 second.

facts.text: The client reference supplied describes 503 responses as indicating service unavailability.
The supplied reference contains no description of automatic retry behavior.
The retry-configuration section of the supplied reference is marked as forthcoming and contains no content.

forbidden_additions: Acceptance of automatic retry on 503 without documented evidence.
Acceptance of a three-retry limit or exponential backoff without documentation.
An invented citation of a retry-configuration section with content.
preserve: 503 meaning as service unavailability from the supplied reference.
Honest status of retry documentation as forthcoming without content.
